scope: Seventh original playable direction sample: one24x16 environmental-stealth level, three ordinary-action solutions, original bitmap art and Canvas2D feedback. This is a local2D short sample informed by environmental stealth. It is not an upstream source/asset integration, native3D title, or commercial product acceptance.

checks.name: Original art and gameplay state stay distinct
checks.observed: Five active ImageGen bitmaps: actual material atlas, original props, corrected directional actors, scene banner, and empty-desk/unlit-lamp/off-switch state variants. Scene banner is only establishing art; the collision map and guard systems use the actual tile model.

checks.name: Real light, sight and sound decisions
checks.observed: All three ordinary plans and manual replay complete. Leaving the gallery lamp on or omitting the lure stones on their respective demonstrated crossings causes capture. Terrain, crouch/walk/run, occlusion, facing, proximity and accumulated suspicion are actual engine inputs.

checks.name: Dynamic states receive real alternate art
checks.observed: Collected archive uses the empty velvet tray, extinguished lantern has no flame, switched-off lever uses its raised state. Removed blue rectangle covers. All three alpha atlases have genuine background transparency.

checks.name: Directional identity and visibility readability
checks.observed: North-facing rogue/watchman first cells were corrected by ImageGen to rear views; east/south/west maintained. Player ring and heading arrow, guard selection, actual suspicion bars and wall-clipped field/proximity aids provide interactive feedback.

checks.name: Production geometry and rendering purity
checks.observed: Nine1440x960 production frames reviewed, covering all three routes and unlit/impact/search/pickup/victory/failure states; 384 grid mappings and4 outside edges verified. Each draw leaves encode(world) identical.

checks.name: Browser interaction and layout review
checks.observed: Actual browser checked ordinary blackout victory (~60s), takeover, manual point path/E lamp interaction, C/Space keys, finite stone count, guard selection, route/vision toggles, full-screen feedback and pause/exit, paused reload, desktop and390px responsive layouts. Browser evidence is recorded separately.

fixes_from_review: Corrected0–100 suspicion/exposure rendering instead of treating raw awareness as a0–1 fraction.
Imported actual engine vision distance, half-angle and proximity; rendered wall-clipped proximity ring and actual patrol routes.
Added real empty/archive, unlit/lamp and off/switch artwork instead of covering the original sprite.
Kept full-screen controls in separate top/bottom rows, added real-time compact light/noise/alert/objective readouts.
Corrected won/lost instructions and completion labels.
Explicit user start/takeover positions the stage using actual viewport height; ordinary narrow-screen direction buttons are44x44.
Kept all prior sample files/assets/save keys separate; preservation baseline covers2587 earlier files.

references.role: Primary official reference for environmental stealth
Primary mechanics reference for lighting, footsteps, crouching and guard investigation

remaining: Real phone hardware multi-pointer behavior, orientation and mobile full-screen remain unverified; real controller callbacks cover simultaneous pointers and cancellation.
Long-running performance profiling and broad browser/device compatibility remain unverified.
One short map with static directional sprite artwork and limited scenarios; no native3D geometry, online multiplayer or audible soundtrack/footstep audio.
Human emotional appeal, willingness to keep playing and commercial product readiness need actual playtesting.
